_meta.title: CANON Resource Manifest
_meta.note: Real, well-known open tools/models (truth VERIFIED). Schneider-specific items flagged VERIFY. Licenses accurate to best knowledge — confirm per version before production (esp. PyMuPDF AGPL, asyncua LGPL, Qwen license per size). No live web crawl performed.

resources.name: node-opcua
resources.purpose: Ingest M580 embedded OPC UA address space; live subscriptions
resources.reason: Best JS/TS OPC UA stack; browsable, subscriptions, alarms/events

resources.name: asyncua (FreeOpcUa)
resources.purpose: Python OPC UA client/server for backend ingestion
resources.reason: Pairs with FastAPI backend; simple async API

resources.name: open62541
resources.purpose: High-performance/embedded OPC UA; test servers
resources.reason: Only if embedded/perf needed; heavier for a hackathon

resources.name: Prosys OPC UA Simulation Server / node-opcua server
resources.purpose: Stand-in OPC UA machine for demo ingestion
resources.reason: Demo OPC UA without physical PLC

resources.name: pymodbus
resources.purpose: Read/write registers to Modicon/Altivar/PowerLogic; run a Modbus sim server
resources.reason: Simplest path to real Schneider device I/O + built-in simulator server

resources.name: modbus-serial / jsmodbus
resources.purpose: Modbus in the Node backend
resources.reason: Prefer pymodbus with FastAPI backend

resources.name: OpenPLC Runtime + Editor
resources.purpose: Realistic soft-PLC executing ST logic, exposes Modbus — best 'real PLC' demo without hardware
resources.reason: Adds credibility: permissive logic runs in a real soft-PLC over Modbus

resources.name: CODESYS Control (demo runtime)
resources.purpose: Industry-standard soft PLC (2h demo runtime)
resources.reason: License friction for a hackathon; OpenPLC is freer

resources.name: CANON deterministic process sim
resources.purpose: TK-401 mass-balance: valve fills, pump drains, pressure, alarms, permissives — reproducible
resources.reason: Zero-dependency, deterministic, demo-safe; already live

resources.name: SKAB — Skoltech Anomaly Benchmark
resources.purpose: Real recorded sensor trace w/ labelled anomalies driving live values/alarms
resources.reason: Real data → real alarms; bundled offline

resources.name: PyMuPDF (fitz)
resources.purpose: Extract text/tables/metadata from Schneider PDFs with page provenance
resources.reason: Fast, accurate; mind AGPL for redistribution

resources.name: pdfplumber
resources.purpose: Table-oriented PDF extraction (permissive license)
resources.reason: MIT alternative for register-map tables

resources.name: Docling (IBM)
resources.purpose: Layout-aware doc parsing to JSON/markdown
resources.reason: Nice for scale; overkill for prototype

resources.name: Qwen2.5-Coder (7B/32B) — local
resources.purpose: Natural language → structured widget JSON, on-prem/private
resources.reason: Strong JSON/coding; data stays local; is CANON's fine-tune base

resources.name: Hosted LLM (e.g. Claude) — optional
resources.purpose: Higher-fidelity proposals + tool/JSON output when privacy allows
resources.reason: Industrial privacy favors local; keep as optional adapter

resources.name: vLLM / Ollama
resources.purpose: Serve the local model to server.py
resources.reason: OpenAI-compatible → drop-in with existing backend

resources.name: BGE-M3 / bge-large (BAAI)
resources.purpose: Retrieve verified engineering context (corpus RAG)
resources.reason: Strong local retrieval; no API needed

resources.name: OpenAI text-embedding-3 / Voyage / Cohere
resources.purpose: Backup embeddings if hosted allowed
resources.reason: Local BGE preferred for privacy

resources.name: bge-reranker-v2-m3 / Cohere Rerank
resources.purpose: Reorder retrieved chunks
resources.reason: Corpus is small — NOT needed for prototype

resources.name: PostgreSQL
resources.purpose: Store machines/signals/commands/alarms/bindings/revisions/evidence/audit
resources.reason: One DB for relational + vector (pgvector) + graph (adjacency)

resources.name: pgvector
resources.purpose: Embed + retrieve corpus/docs inside Postgres
resources.reason: Simplest vector option; no extra service

resources.name: SQLite
resources.purpose: Zero-config local dev/demo persistence
resources.reason: Great for a self-contained demo

resources.name: In-memory graph (adjacency) / NetworkX / Apache AGE
resources.purpose: asset→signal→I/O→PLC→command→alarm→HMI→test→revision
resources.reason: Prototype uses in-memory graph; Neo4j is overkill

resources.name: JSON Schema + Zod + Pydantic
resources.purpose: Structured-output contract + typed binding checks (NOT AI)
resources.reason: Enum-constrained schema is the anti-hallucination guarantee

resources.name: React + TypeScript + SVG/Canvas
resources.purpose: Schema-driven component registry for production HMI
resources.reason: Component registry maps JSON spec→validated widget

resources.name: Three.js
resources.purpose: WebGL digital twin (tank/pump/valve/pipes)
resources.reason: Operational digital twin; already vendored

resources.name: uPlot / ECharts
resources.purpose: High-perf technical trends
resources.reason: uPlot for realtime trends; prototype uses SVG/canvas now

resources.name: FastAPI (Python) / Node
resources.purpose: Generation endpoint, validation, OPC UA/Modbus bridge, auth
resources.reason: Pairs with pymodbus/asyncua + local LLM; server.py already uses it

resources.name: WebSocket (Server-Sent Events alt)
resources.purpose: Push live PLC state/alarms/validation to HMI
resources.reason: Runtime needs live updates; prototype uses in-page tick now

resources.name: Vitest + Pytest + Playwright
resources.purpose: Test invalid-tag/range/permissive/blocked/allowed/regeneration
resources.reason: CANON auto-derives tests from the model already (concept BUILT)

resources.name: Structured logging + OpenTelemetry (Prometheus/Grafana P3)
resources.purpose: Trace AI requests, validation, commands, latency, revisions
resources.reason: Audit trail (built) covers demo; OTel for production

resources.name: JWT auth + RBAC + command authorization
resources.purpose: Role separation (propose≠approve); PLC writes only via backend contract
resources.reason: Never browser→raw PLC write; audit every command

resources.name: Docker (frontend static + backend + model)
resources.purpose: Reproducible runtime; offline-capable
resources.reason: One-command bring-up for the venue

resources.name: transformers + PEFT + TRL + bitsandbytes
resources.purpose: QLoRA fine-tune the local model on compiler-generated data
resources.reason: Turns the LLM into a domain 'CANON brain'; scripts built
